name: command-autopilot
description: Use all of Claude Code, beginner to expert. From your first task on, it lays out a menu of the high-leverage moves that fit (you pick), handles the basics itself, and stays quiet otherwise. Open source, zero telemetry.

aggressiveness.title: Aggressiveness
aggressiveness.description: teaching | normal | quiet. teaching = silent help + command tips; normal = silent help, tips only at costly misses; quiet = silent help only

language.title: Guidance language
language.description: en or zh — language of injected guidance

enable_plan_gate.title: Auto plan mode
enable_plan_gate.description: Automatically enter plan mode before substantial design/build/refactor work
